method.corpus: One related multirepository set, with three exact-commit labelled snapshots
method.arms: Same Pi tools and prompts; candidate additionally loads the unmodified native RTK v0.48.0 extension
method.attribution: A combined native compression-hook and agent-response experiment; not a deterministic fixed-action replay
method.rawRecovery: Normal command required before raw repeat; complete source reads always available in both arms
method.fixtureNoise: 64 controlled documentation line changes per repository in both review scenarios
method.fixes: Seeded runtime regressions committed in each disposable repository before the main matrix; model repairs produce visible diffs
method.ordering: Sequential calls; arm order alternates by scenario and repetition; no fixed sampler seed
method.quality: Predeclared strict criterion: all 12 pairs usable, both arms pass every grader, candidate exposed in every pair
method.benefit: At least 15% fewer total tokens, at most 10% more elapsed time, positive median paired token reduction
method.usage: Sum input+output+cacheRead+cacheWrite across all assistant messages; ACP zero counters and configured zero prices not used
method.elapsed: Wall time of run plus post-run hidden checks; not pure provider latency
limitations: No OS sandbox for generated source
No complete application or AIFHub lifecycle validation
Provider model alias is not weights attestation

audit.privacyScope: Aggregate-only output; checks file bytes and credential names, not a complete secret scanner or OS isolation proof.

diagnostics.bytesScope: stdout UTF-8 bytes; elapsed-time footer can vary

supplementary.reason: Pre-matrix pilot; fix seeds were still uncommitted, so restoring original source gave empty final diffs. Protocol corrected before main inference.

retention.publicArtifacts: Aggregate results and harness only; no raw traces, source copies or private label map
retention.scope: Current multirepository series. Earlier experiment retention is reported separately.
